notes.title: THE GAME IS OUT!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We were finally able to release this game. This is our first experience in this genre, so we'd love to read your feedback on the game!

All money earned from the sale of this game will go to a new project - Hentai farm. Now we have enough experience to make quality animated scenes. The only problem is the lack of free time. 

We will only grow and try to make the highest quality hentai for you. Thank you! 


Wolfi team.
